In Western countries, the past decade has seen a veritable avalanche of essays and books raging at the dying of the light. A rough consensus has taken hold that the world is witnessing the end of an age. The liberal ascendancy that followed the American triumph in the Cold War—with the subsequent expansion of both democracy and free markets—is now over.
